mass_notation_clarification.canonical_accounting_identity: delta_storage = sum(signed_external_amounts), where positive signed amount enters the SWAP accounting domain and negative signed amount leaves it.
mass_notation_clarification.case_equation_Q_bottom_rule: Where an initial TB09 expanded case equation writes '- Q_bottom', Q_bottom denotes the non-negative outward bottom-flux amount listed under outputs. An upward bottom flux is represented only as a positive input. Implementation evidence must use one canonical signed bottom amount and must never book both representations.
mass_notation_clarification.internal_transfer_rule: Internal transfers between SWAP-owned stores, including surface-to-soil infiltration, cancel from the external ledger.
mass_notation_clarification.tolerance_rule: Mass conservation remains hard. No head, physics, fallback or performance tolerance may absorb missing water.
